news_variations.name: symbolic
news_variations.text: A street art stencil mural in the style of Banksy on a weathered concrete wall. The artwork depicts this scene: Galaxy Research cuts CLARITY Act 2026 passage odds to 50%, citing a busy legislative calendar. Polymarket odds hover near 49%. Monochrome stencil with selective color accents, satirical and thought-provoking composition. The word 'Galaxy Research Cuts' appears as a small hand-painted tag in the corner. If the topic mentions brands, cryptocurrencies, or projects, integrate their symbols as stenciled icons within the composition. Drips, overspray, raw urban texture.
